summary: 1935 L-4 tower on Lindstrom Peak, St. Joe National Forest, four miles south of St. Maries, Idaho; county disputed (Benewah per Forest Lookouts; Shoshone per firelookout.com and the FFLA list); destroyed 1965, and no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1965; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: L-4 tower; a patrol tower about 1 mile southeast is noted

evidence.supports: 1935 L-4 tower; patrol tower 1 mile southeast; destroyed 1965
evidence.quote: 1935: L-4 tower. Patrol tower 1 mile southeast. Destroyed 1965.

evidence.supports: four miles south of St. Maries
elevation 4,695 feet, St. Joe National Forest
1935 tower with L-4 cab, per Kresek
FFLA list gives Shoshone county and Tower Gone

corrections.why: Sources disagree. The Forest Lookouts page lists Lindstrom Peak under BENEWAH COUNTY. Firelookout.com (cite 1) places the tower four miles south of St. Maries but also says Shoshone County, Idaho, and the FFLA list (cite 4) says Shoshone. Idaho Fire Lookouts (cite 2) gives no county. Not applied until checked against county GIS.

notes_for_editor: County: sources disagree. The record, the FFLA list and firelookout.com say Shoshone; the Forest Lookouts page says Benewah. The story now says the county is disputed. Correction proposed, not applied; check against county GIS. Dates 1935 and 1965 agree across pages. No staffing, no photo, and no site-today source found. One web search returned nothing about this tower.
